evidence: Market news leading into May 8, 2022, reflects severe downward pressure and widespread bearish sentiment across the cryptocurrency sector. Bitcoin plunged to four-month lows, triggering over $407 million in liquidations. Multiple analysts and on-chain reports indicate that short-term holders have been aggressively selling, pushing BTC below $36,000 and threatening further drops toward support levels between $28,000 and $30,000 (or even lower targets around $21,000-$23,000). While there were brief signs of prices steadying around the $36k mark, the persistent selling momentum and macro headwinds make a 24-hour rebound less likely than a continuation or consolidation downward.
